d:
It's been almost 6 months since the Motorola Signature launched. The launch offers are gone, plenty of new competitors have arrived, and I've spent the last few weeks using it as my daily driver. So... has it actually held up? In this long-term review, I talk about the real-world experience, covering the design, battery life, cameras, display, performance, software, and whether it's still worth buying in the second half of 2026.
